note: Bow Valley Provincial Park, 14 km east of Canmore on Hwy 1, beside Lac Des Arcs (popular with windsurfers). Sites sit in aspen and spruce; from the west side the lake shows through the trees (site 23). The hand pump's water is only for putting out fires; the nearest sewage disposal station is at Bow Valley Campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Sep 4, 2026) and shop: 28 unserviced sites C$31, 31-61 ft, no pull-throughs; vault toilets, non-potable pump, no dump; season Apr 30 - Oct 12; reservable on the shop. Lakeview kept on the shop's site-23 photos (lake through the trees, ~40 m behind a treed belt). Phone 1-866-686-0339.
